description.text: The other fifth expansion of the Sword & Shield series, released together with Single Strike Master on 22 January 2021 and holding the Rapid Strike cards. Rapid Strike Urshifu VMAX leads it: its attack discards all its Energy to do 120 damage to each of two of the opponent's Pokémon. Empoleon V, whose Ability, while it is in the Active Spot, takes away the Abilities of the opponent's Basic Pokémon that have no Rule Box, Octillery, which searches the deck for a Rapid Strike card, and Rapid Strike Energy join it, with Victini VMAX and Corviknight VMAX. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 70, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon V and Supporters, some Pokémon V in a second version drawn as a full scene, rainbow Hyper Rare Pokémon VMAX and Supporters with a second Rapid Strike Urshifu VMAX drawn as a full scene, and gold Ultra Rare Octillery, Level Ball and Rapid Strike Energy. In English most of its cards came out in Battle Styles in March 2021.
